title: Ageless & Definitive Zero
body:
"_These_ are my weapons!"

Strictly more...

This is my main TaCZ pack, this will include the most content!

Currently adds:
- AK-74M
- AKS-74U
- CL-40
- FN MAXIMI
- G41K
- Glock-18
- L96A1
- M82A1 .50 Cal
- M82A2 .50 Cal
- M590
- RPK-74
- S&W M500
- UMP50
- XM214 Microgun
- XM635

_You can make your own video showcasing this addon if you want. You may also use this in your servers, just make sure to credit me._

_This addon uses TaCZ assets and in no way I am claiming these assets as my own._
